job.description:
Working Student Data Analytics (m/f/d), Brightline Energy, Essen

Our analytics team turns meter, grid and customer data into the reports that run the business. You join for 20 hours per week, hybrid in Essen.

What you do
- Write SQL to prepare data for monthly KPI reporting
- Clean and validate data from our ERP and billing systems
- Build dashboards in Power BI and keep them up to date
- Automate recurring analyses with Python (pandas)

What you bring
- Enrolled in a Master's programme in data science, computer science or a related field
- SQL and Python
- Experience with messy business data
- Fluent English; German at B1 level is a plus
- dbt or Airflow is a plus

en.subject: Application for the Working Student Data Analytics position
en.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your analytics team turns meter and customer data into monthly reports, and that is the work I want to do next to my M.Sc. in Business Analytics.

At Northwind Traders I build the Power BI sales reports that 12 regional managers open every Monday, on a SQL data model that refreshes each night. Before our CRM migration I cleaned and matched more than 80,000 customer records from two systems, and I automated a weekly margin analysis in Python that used to take a day in Excel. During my internship at Contoso Logistics I analysed delivery times for 300 routes in SQL.

I can work 20 hours a week and I live in Essen, so the hybrid setup suits me well. I would be glad to show you some of my reports in an interview.

Kind regards,
